title: The GM rolls for monsters: the goblin's hide attempt is an NPC roll

Goblin.personality_traits: Cowardly but vicious in a pack
Goblin.combat_style: Hits and runs; flees when outnumbered

llm_context.canon: Table rule: players roll their own dice; the GM rolls for NPCs and monsters. The goblin sentry is trying to hide from Aria behind the sarcophagus.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I listen at the archway before going through.

actions.text: Beyond the arch, stone scrapes — small and quick — then nothing. Whatever is in there has gone very still.
